This unit gives a controlled nonlinear gravity/scalar construction after exact all-mode finite-grid closure fails in the specified fixed local class. A supplied canonical Hamiltonian admits finite-order alias-free brackets, analytic-time evolution and convergent sampled constraints: exponential analytic sampling error for the spectral law and second-order error for the actual centered finite-range law. The same unit now includes a supplied positive scalar-clock density, the full metric-dependent lapse variation, continuum constraint propagation, common-time analytic approximation and explicit compatible data.

The clock proof retains the extra lapse-variation terms away from the constraint surface. It proves equality with the square-root Hamiltonian gradient only on that surface and propagates the constraints using a positive continuum energy. All original unit-lapse results and their exact historical evidence remain preserved.

- [Complete canonical theorem](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/bd6f6e6368d615bfc0437760e2396cd471837cd7/docs/NONLINEAR_CANONICAL_GRAVITY_ANALYTIC_APPROXIMATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-30.md), [standalone primary](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/bd6f6e6368d615bfc0437760e2396cd471837cd7/scripts/nonlinear_canonical_gravity_analytic_approximation_2026_09_30.py) and [actual source-bound output](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/bd6f6e6368d615bfc0437760e2396cd471837cd7/logs/runner-cache/nonlinear_canonical_gravity_analytic_approximation_2026_09_30.txt).
